# Cursor artwork

The repository README displays the [product card](project-card.webp). The matching [product icon](cursor-icon.png) uses a transparent background. The card follows Synapse's portfolio composition with a black wordmark, warm ivory ceramic, glass and a single petrol accent. The illustration shows two distinct pointers directed toward the same location.

Pixel Brewery generated the artwork with ImageGen. The card metadata records its source, dimensions and alternative text. Use the product name and accompanying README description as the textual sources for the project.

The [website hero](../../site/public/assets/hero.webp) is a 2022 × 778 panoramic interpretation of the project card, generated with ImageGen. The website uses the same product icon as its favicon.
